title: Mt.FUJI 100 — HISTORY (歴代優勝者・10年ヒストリー)
claims: The 100-mile event began in 2012 under the name UTMF, with Julien Chorier winning in 18:53:12 over 156.0 km with 8,530 m of gain.
The official winners table lists the race name as UTMF from 2012 to 2022, as FUJI in 2023 and as FUJI100mi from 2024 to 2026.
The 2026 FUJI100mi is listed as 165.3 km with 6,461 m of gain, won by Chris Myers of the USA in 17:50:13 and Ying Li of China in 22:18:12.
The 2025 FUJI100mi is listed as 168.0 km with 6,254 m of gain, won by Joaquin Lopez in 17:48:40 and Manyee Cheung in 23:42:00.
The 2024 FUJI100mi is listed as 166.6 km with 7,039 m of gain, won by Guomin Deng in 19:10:34 and Courtney Dauwalter in 19:21:22.
The 2023 race is listed as FUJI over 164.7 km with 6,451 m of gain, and the 2022 race as UTMF over 157.9 km with 6,388 m of gain.
The 2016 UTMF is listed as 44.8 km with 1,926 m of gain, marked as shortened with the finish line changed to Asagiri Roadside Station.
The 2020 and 2021 editions are listed as cancelled, and the table has no 2017 row.
The winners table also lists an under-100-mile event that appears as STY from 2012 to 2019 and as KAI from 2022 onwards, with ASUMI40k added in 2025.
